summary: Native Android chat screen declutter. The linked pull requests become one app bar chip ("#9 +1") that opens a bottom sheet with one 64 dp row per link; Unlink and its confirm dialog live in the sheet. Tokens, cost and the last turn's time hide behind a tap on the title (one usage line under the app bar) and a Usage row in the agent settings screen. The subtitle drops the model ("SSG · Working"). "Worked for" shows only on turns of 30 s or more, and on any turn after a long press. While a turn runs, a Steer | Queue segment sits in a footer row inside the composer card, next to one "model · mode" chip that opens the agent settings; the old hint line and the trailing model button are gone. Stop is a 48 dp icon button. The subagent row is one 56 dp row with a status icon and a chevron. Metadata, eyebrows and notices use the sans bodySmall style; monospace stays for code, paths, diffs and todos. Rhythm: 16 dp margins, 20 dp between turns, 48 dp targets. Every action and accessibility label stays.

desktop.reason: The desktop chat has its own layout (PR links in the chat header, usage in the context meter); this change is a phone layout only and changes no desktop code.

reactNativeIos.followUpRelease: The next Expo OTA release brings the same declutter to apps/mobile/src/screens/ThreadScreen.tsx (PR chip and sheet replacing PrLinksBanner.tsx, usage on a title tap, the Steer | Queue segment, the model and mode chip, the Worked for threshold). Until then the Expo app keeps its current layout; no Expo code changes here, so there is no unflagged Expo behaviour.

sharedBackendApi.reason: The pull-requests:links and pull-requests:unlink calls, the turn delivery field and the thread metadata are read and sent as before; PrLinkRows.text and the shared tests/fixtures/pr-link-rows.json are unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: Nothing new is stored. The usage line, the PR sheet and the long-press duration are transient screen state.

updateRelease.reason: A UI-only change for the next native Android release; no package identity, signing, version, schema, deep link or update channel changes.
